question: How many times has India hosted the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup (One Day)?
solution:
The correct answer is **__4__**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **** ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup** 

 
 
• **4 times **times has India hosted the** ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup (One Day)**
 
• ​The** One Day International (ODI) Cricket World Cup**, also known as the** ICC Men's Cricket World Cup**, is the sport's global championship.
 
• Every four years, the** International Cricket Council (ICC**), the sport's governing body, hosts the competition, which consists of preliminary qualification stages and a finals **tournament**.
 
• The competition is one of the most watched athletic events in the world, according to the **ICC**, who also refer to it as the** "flagship event of the international cricket calendar."**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first** ODI cricket **match had been played just four years prior, in **June 1975**, when England hosted the** first World Cup**.
 
• The first men's event was preceded by a **Women's Cricket World Cup**, while a competition with multiple international teams was held as early as **1912 **when **Australia**, **England**, and **South Africa** competed in a **triangular **tournament of** Test matches**.

**Note -**

 
• The **1987** World Cup was jointly hosted by **India** and** Pakistan**, with matches played across both countries.
 
• India co-hosted the** 1996** World Cup with Pakistan and Sri Lanka, and the tournament was played across 22 venues in the three countries.
 
• In 2011 India,Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh Host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup.
 
• The most recent World Cup held in India was in** 2023.**
